{{Quote|The fortress is deep in the Valley of Kraau.|Tau|<ref name="ForceWar2" />}}
The '''Valley of Kraau''' was located on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] word [[Ska Gora]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. During the [[invasion of the Tython system]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], the Rakata [[Fall of Ska Gora|captured]] Ska Gora and constructed a [[Rakatan Base Prime|base]] in the Valley of Kraau. In approximately [[25,792 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'' dates itself to [[25,793 BBY]] and takes place while [[Daegen Lok]] is still [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Bogan]]. According to author {{Twitter|timlebbon|status/325244030705340417|[[Tim Lebbon]]|quote=@DigiFluid Sure, it's pretty much at the same time as the Force Storm arc.|archivedate=20200813210755}}, the events of the novel take place roughly concurrently to the events of [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm|''Force Storm'']], the first arc of the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi|''Dawn of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. Lok leaves Bogan during the second arc, [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|''The Prisoner of Bogan'']] and the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|first issue]] of the subsequent [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force War|''Force War'']] arc states that one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] has passed since the previous arc's events. Therefore, the events of [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 2]] must take place in approximately [[25,792 BBY]].</ref> the Rakata's enemies, the [[Je'daii Order]], found the base with the help of the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], who used [[Force shadow]] to sense it. The Je'daii subsequently [[Attack on Ska Gora|attacked]] Ska Gora, but were caught in a trap.<ref name="ForceWar2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Valley of Kraau first appeared in [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]], a comic in the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force War|''Force War'']] arc of the series ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'', which was written by [[John Ostrander]] and illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]]. The issue was publised on [[November 20]], [[2013]].<ref name="Date 1">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/22-793/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-Force-War-1|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi—Force War #1}}</ref> The valley was first identified in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|following issue]] of ''Force War''<ref name="ForceWar2" /> which was and first published on [[December 18]] [[2013]].<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/exclusive-star-wars-comics-preview-december-titles-and-february-graphic-novels|text=Exclusive ''Star Wars'' Comics Preview: December Titles and February Graphic Novels}}</ref>
